scope: Canonical product-truth mockup JSON records, with manifest and optional HTML render retained as distinct supporting sources.

authorities.role: Draft-07 record schema: 18 fields, 12 required, additionalProperties=false.
Discovers every mockups/**/*.mockup.json file; validates each against the schema before cross-reference checks.

Checks manifest IDs resolve to source records, status/readiness/version agree, and source entity names belong to entity_registry. Does not require all source files to have manifest entries and does not compare manifest summary/tags.
Search manifest; contains 9 mockup entries in this snapshot, while 10 canonical mockup files exist. Manifest data must not overwrite artifact metadata.
Product-truth boundary: metadata JSON and a separately rendered screen are one artifact, not separate competing Mockup nodes.

observed_population.realization_and_shape_version: Absent in all 10 records. Do not insert defaults.

record_identity.native_id: Exact metadata.id, including product/name. A bare screen is a reference within product context, not a global identity.
record_identity.locator: Empty string denotes whole JSON record.
record_identity.metadata: Complete parsed source JSON object, without allowlisting, flattening, defaults or manifest overlays.
record_identity.title: Authored title string.
record_identity.path_check: Under docs/product-truth/mockups/<product>/<name>.mockup.json, id must correspond to <product>/<name>; resolve inside the supplied snapshot. Fail duplicate IDs rather than dictionary-overwriting one record.
record_identity.screen: Keep exact screen separate from id. Multiple products may use the same bare screen name.

fields.name: component
fields.meaning: AC component namespace, e.g. ux-prototyping; not interchangeable with docs/components.json graph registry key ux_prototyping.

fields.name: screen
fields.meaning: Bare screen identifier referenced by flow step/branch screen.

fields.name: entities
fields.meaning: Entity vocabulary from product-truth index; these example-product entities are not new Leafcutter native types.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Whether screen renders demo/mock or real system surface; independent of source provenance and realization.

fields.name: example_product
fields.meaning: Self-declared example marker; never inferred into ownership and never required on real product records.

fields.name: realization
fields.meaning: Existence axis; documented reader default built must not be materialized into authored metadata when absent.

fields.name: renders
fields.meaning: HTML path relative to metadata file directory; null is an explicitly undrawn screen.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Lifecycle state, separate from readiness and realization.

fields.name: superseded_by
fields.meaning: Replacing artifact ID. Do not replace absent by null.

fields.name: readiness
fields.meaning: Persona review state, not lifecycle status or implementation completeness.

fields.name: shape_version
fields.meaning: Record shape convention iteration; absence denotes older convention, not version=1.

element_fields.name: date
element_fields.meaning: Authored JSON string; schema defines no date format. Do not coerce to date.

nested_shapes.shape: Ordered string array; preserve empty array and duplicates if authored.
Optional ordered string array; absent is distinct from [].
Ordered object array with correlated action/by/date/note. Schema allows empty array and empty objects. Preserve optional member absence and object boundaries.

native_property_exposure.scalars: Expose every authored scalar under its original name, applying shared reserved-name collision policy to id/title/summary etc. Keep metadata source distinct from SourceReference.
native_property_exposure.arrays: Expose homogeneous string arrays directly. For provenance use escaped JSON Pointer leaves such as /provenance/0/action and /provenance/0/note; never collapse correlated entries into unrelated parallel arrays.
native_property_exposure.shape: Shared value-free shape metadata must retain explicit null renders/superseded_by, empty containers, index ordering and scalar types.
native_property_exposure.round_trip: Flattened properties plus shared shape must reconstruct exact complete metadata object, including schema-valid optional fields absent in today's records.
native_property_exposure.relationships: Any screen, superseded_by, mock_data_ref or component relationship is additional and must not replace original fields. Do not infer Component registry identity by changing hyphens to underscores.

manifest.storage: Separate derived.manifest_record exact object and derived.manifest_source_path / manifest_locator; derived.manifest_registered boolean identifies whether a record was registered. Manifest data is supporting context, never merged into metadata.
manifest.index_root: entity_registry/search_dimensions/index version are store context, not per-Mockup authored fields. Derived by_component/by_entity/by_flow/by_ac indexes must not create duplicate records.
manifest.missing_entry: Preserve sign-in Mockup because the canonical validator reads it; mark manifest_registered=false. Do not manufacture an entry or mutate the store.
manifest.stale_entry: Retain full manifest object unchanged and optionally list differing shared field names under derived.manifest_differing_fields; source JSON remains field authority.

html_render.path: Resolve renders only when a string, relative to the canonical JSON parent; reject absolute paths, URI schemes, traversal outside the repository and escaping symlinks.
html_render.storage: Supporting derived.render_source_path plus hash, and exact decoded source body if exposing render content. HTML is a sibling source attachment, not canonical JSON metadata and not an independent Mockup node.
html_render.content_handling: Never execute or parse instructions inside HTML. Read as UTF-8 source; avoid inferred screenshot text or visual state.
html_render.null: Do not read a guessed filename when renders=null. No render content fields are needed; explicit metadata null is authoritative.
html_render.missing_file: Record an explicit derived.render_missing=true if a safe declared path is absent; do not discard valid metadata or claim the screen was rendered.

safe_discovery: Scan only docs/product-truth/mockups/**/*.mockup.json, mirroring canonical validator. Exclude leafcutter-web/fixtures and unrelated prompt/mock JSON.
An absent optional store may return []. A present malformed file, malformed JSON/object, missing identity or duplicate identity must fail explicitly, never be skipped.
Read UTF-8 with BOM support; default Windows text encoding corrupts punctuation in these records.

Inspect optional manifest entries to attach supporting context. Reject duplicate Mockup manifest IDs, unsafe paths, or registered paths that point at a different artifact identity. Missing sign-in registration is known source debt, not permission to drop a schema-valid file.
Use common.relative on resolved JSON/render/manifest paths before reading; no path outside supplied immutable snapshot.

Schema validation may be performed explicitly but must not default or normalize data. Preserve exact authored optional values. Unknown fields from a future schema must not disappear through an old hardcoded field allowlist.

coder_contract.return: One NativeRecord per canonical metadata file; kind Mockup, native_id metadata.id, source_path relative JSON path, locator empty, title metadata.title, description metadata.summary, metadata exact parsed object, supporting sources in derived.
acceptance_checks: Inspected checkout emits 10 records, including unregistered sign-in, with 9 associated manifest records and no fixture duplicate.
All record metadata equals source JSON exactly; no absent realization/shape_version defaults appear.
Cart retains current source summary and tags even though its manifest still calls it a stub.
All provenance entries and action/by/date/note leaves remain queryable with correct per-entry correlation and date strings unchanged.
Use a synthetic valid record covering all 18 fields including realization, shape_version, deprecated/superseded_by, and empty provenance to demonstrate complete schema coverage.
Explicit null renders and optional absent superseded_by/tags remain distinguishable from empty arrays/strings.
5 existing rendered HTML source attachments retain exact body/hash/path separately; 5 null renders do not trigger guessed file reads.
Duplicate record IDs, duplicate manifest IDs, malformed JSON, identity mismatch, unsafe paths and symlink escapes produce explicit errors.
Metadata and supporting context survive shared native-property encoding/decoding without collisions or loss.
